import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w,A,ph,B,k1,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5 = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    return A*np.cos(w*t+ph) + B + k1*x + c1*v + c2/v + c3*np.log(x) + c4*x*v + c5*np.cos(w*t)/v
